name: How much does it cost to replace a faucet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace a faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace a faucet varies depending on several factors, including the type and brand of the new faucet you choose, and any complexities with your existing plumbing. While Alpha-Plumbing Services charges for labor, the faucet itself is a separate cost that customers typically provide. We offer transparent pricing for our installation services. For an accurate estimate tailored to your specific situation, we recommend scheduling a consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Faucet replacement cost varies based on the new faucet's price, labor, and plumbing complexity. We provide transparent labor estimates.
